default.title: Obtain the Sinner
default.text: If you're seeking the White Tiger's protection, you'd better be generous with the offerings—Where's the grub? Take me there! Think of all the steps I took to come here! My stomach's already growling.

default.title: Raise to Phase 1
default.text: A nap in a warm bed after a hearty meal, then wake up and repeat... Ahh, one can never dream of such a carefree life in the mountains!

default.title: Raise to Phase 3
default.text: Heed my call and bow down, for I am Lord of all mountain beasts.

default.title: Level Start
default.text: Let's get this over with quickly. Can't wait to get back and chow down on a nice steak.

default.title: Victory
default.text: Honor the Mountain Lord, and luck will be on your side.

default.title: Lose Battles
default.text: Little brat! That scratch hurt.

default.title: Ultimate Skill
default.text: All shall grovel to your Mountain Lord!

default.title: Die in Battles
default.text: Caught me... off guard...

default.title: Greeting
default.text: Hey, there you are! Come on, come on! I just saw two people grappling over there! Let's go take a good look!

default.title: Conversation 1
default.text: You humans are so hard to please, always making a fuss about all those fancy clothes and jewelry. But... this meat sure is deliciously grilled, and the wine's not bad either. Hehe, I shall sample it all...

default.title: Conversation 2
default.text: "The monkey rules a tigerless mountain"? Don't make me laugh. If monkeys were half as smart as you humans, they wouldn't spend all day hanging from trees.

default.title: Conversation 3
default.text: Hey, I just learned some new words from the little one here. Like ****, and ****, and ****. Wha—I can't say those? Why? But I like the sound of them!

default.title: Special Conversation 1
default.text: What's that smell on you? Weird. Not human, more like... roast goose, braised pork, poached offal... but which exactly? Need to get a better taste of you...

default.title: Special Conversation 2
default.text: A tiger needs to eat its fill, and so does a human! Screw the world! Don't you spare another thought worrying about all that stuff. Have a couple more drinks with me! Burps! Cheers!

default.title: Special Conversation 3
default.text: People down the mountain love tying red strings on me. They say it brings good luck, and the more you tie, the more effective it is. You can give me one too. That'll guarantee your days are safe and merry. Hmm? No more space? Well, how about my pinky finger? It'll be eye-catching!

default.title: Full Compliance
default.text: For someone so frail, you've pulled off quite a few wonderful feats. Hmm, you've got a tiger within you. If you ever run into trouble out there, come find me in the mountains. I'll make sure you're always fed.

default.title: Idle
default.text: Your place is still the best. So cool and breezy... Makes me want to lie down for a nap... Zzz...

default.title: Annoyed
default.text: Keep your paws off me. Touch me again and I'll chop them off.

default.title: Special Attention
default.text: Ugh, ate too much and I'm falling asleep. Come here, stay for another nap.

default.title: Dispatch
default.text: Hunting? Sure, you asked the right person.

default.title: Dispatch Complete
default.text: Hurry up and dig in! The meat's getting cold.

default.title: Level Up
default.text: Woohoo! Can I get even stronger?

default.title: Pat Head
default.text: Yeah, right there, scratch me a bit more. Mmm, so good...
